topic_zh: 借用：& 和 &mut 的规则
topic_en: Rust borrowing: the rules of & and &mut

xhs.title: Rust 借用：一条规则就够了
xhs.body:
第 8 课：& 和 &mut
只想用一下，不想交出所有权？加 & 借给它
想让函数改它：变量用 mut，再借 &mut
规则只有一条：多个只读 & 或者一个 &mut，不能同时
借用在最后一次使用后就结束，先读完再改就能编译
考考你：r = &s 还在用，中间 s.push('a')，能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: Rust borrowing in one rule: many & readers OR one &mut writer, never both at once. Quick quiz: r = &s is still in use while we call s.push('a'). Does it compile? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: Rust's borrowing rule fits in one line
linkedin.body:
&: lend a value without giving up ownership. Read-only, and you can have many.
&mut: lend it to be changed. Only one at a time.
Mix them and the compiler refuses to build, which rules out data races.
A borrow ends at its last use, so read first, then write.
Quick quiz: r = &s is still in use while we call s.push('a'). Does it compile? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: r = &s 还在用，中间 s.push('a')，能编译吗？
quiz.q_en: r = &s is still in use while we call s.push('a'). Does it compile?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：不能。r 后面还要用，这时不能再可变借用 s（push 需要 &mut）。把 println 挪到 push 前面就能编译。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: no. r is still used later, so s cannot be mutably borrowed for push. Move the println above the push and it compiles.
